title: Sequence a six-week enterprise pilot
scenario:
TOPIC: Plan a six-week enterprise pilot for an invoice assistant
A three-person startup has signed a conditional pilot with a mid-sized retailer. Go-live must happen in six weeks. Security review usually takes two to four weeks; the customer has not supplied sample invoices; one founder owns engineering, another can sell for 20 hours per week, and a contractor is available 10 hours per week. The pilot needs data mapping, a manual fallback, user training, support coverage, and agreed success metrics. Build a dependency-driven execution plan with one owner and definition of done per step, start the longest lead-time work first, include a realistic buffer for customer-controlled tasks, set weekly measurable checkpoints, give dated kill or renegotiation criteria, and identify the top execution risk with mitigation.

expected_elements.name: owner and done state per step

bad_signs.name: shared ownership
bad_signs.pattern: owners?\s*:\s*(?:everyone|the team)|engineering and sales jointly own

bad_signs.name: no contingency
bad_signs.pattern: no buffer needed|assume customer responds immediately

improvement_suggestions: Open the external review immediately because it controls the schedule.
Give each deliverable to exactly one accountable person.
Define an early condition for renegotiating the customer commitment.
